fn ports(pool: &Pool, account: &str) -> HashSet<u16> {
    pool.vendor
        .peers
        .lock()
        .unwrap()
        .iter()
        .filter(|(seen, _)| seen == account)
        .map(|(_, port)| *port)
        .collect()
}
